comparison_scope: Low-cost contract comparison only. No same-task outcome comparison or scientific benefit comparison was run.
candidate_function: Check one user-supplied research-ideation packet for source/anchor structure, contrary evidence, explicit cross-domain mapping, falsifiable experiment fields, and a fail-closed human-review boundary.

adjacent_existing_tools.observed_contract: Validates caller-supplied ResearchEpisodeRequest Goal/Intent lineage, contract digests, policy and budget boundaries, and owner-authority separation.
adjacent_existing_tools.not_a_replacement_because: It does not validate research-gap evidence anchors, contrary evidence, transfer mapping, or falsifiable proposal structure.

adjacent_existing_tools.observed_contract: Validates the fixed checked-out Evidence Program preregistration and run-record tree.
adjacent_existing_tools.not_a_replacement_because: It does not accept one caller-supplied ideation packet and operates on a different fixed dataset contract.

paired_same_task_trial.reason: The adjacent tools require different input contracts and answer different questions; coercing the same packet into them would not be a fair same-task comparison.
paired_same_task_trial.next_low_cost_comparison: If a real non-sensitive research proposal later needs both preflight types, record each tool's independently useful findings and human rework under the same task scope.

retirement_decision.reason: No same-task evidence supports replacement, superiority, or retirement. Preserve uncertainty and keep the new tool default-off.

negative_controls: An exact quote substring is not treated as semantic support or source authentication.
Attached-only sources cannot be counted as evidence anchors.
Missing contrary anchors, unresolved source IDs, missing falsifiers, same-domain transfer labels, and out-of-cutoff used sources cannot receive a ready status.
No output is described as a novel idea, supported finding, independent review, or scientific result.
claim_ceiling: Structural interface comparison and synthetic preflight behavior only; no superiority, scientific validity, or general task benefit is established.
